error.invalid_auth: AirCloud rejected the email or password. Use the email and password used to sign in to the airCloud Go app.
error.account_disabled: This AirCloud account is disabled. Check the account in the airCloud Go app.
error.account_unverified: This AirCloud account has not been verified. Complete verification in the airCloud Go app.
error.account_locked: AirCloud has locked this account after failed sign-in attempts. Wait before trying again and check access in the airCloud Go app.
error.too_many_attempts: AirCloud is limiting sign-in attempts. Wait before trying again.

init.title: OFF compatibility (experimental)
init.description: Select only air conditioners that fail to turn off with the standard settings. Leave empty if your devices work correctly. This option was derived from a reported installation in Brazil; it is not a setting required for all Brazilian devices. Other commands and unselected devices keep their standard behavior.
